framework: meta-evaluation of the Queyi evaluation apparatus

metrics.name: calibration
metrics.definition: 装置声明检出率与其在独立真值上实际检出率之差
metrics.method: 独立靶场(683)实测覆盖 vs 声明口径；代理=逐格不稳定率(676f ~5% => 单回合率 ±~2pp)

metrics.name: discrimination
metrics.definition: 装置区分好/差资产组合的能力 = FD覆盖率超过随机选集的比例
metrics.method: A5 2000 resamples: FD strictly beats random draw
metrics.current_value: AUC≈0.976 (97.6% of 2000); vs random-mean gain +16pp full / +7-12pp mechanism

metrics.name: stability
metrics.definition: 评估结果在检测器噪声/跑间不稳定下是否稳定
metrics.method: inject eps noise, measure selection Jaccard + clean-eval drop (B4); measured run-to-run flip (676f)
metrics.current_value: eps=5% Jaccard0.97/drop0.10pp; eps=15% Jaccard0.89/drop0.37pp; eps=20% onset; eps=50% collapse

metrics.name: fairness
metrics.definition: 装置对各 defect_type 覆盖的公平性（系统性盲区）
metrics.method: per-type blind-spot rate; count types >50% blind; blind-spot range
metrics.rating: poor (true property of object, not a flaw)

metrics.name: efficiency
metrics.definition: 评估成本效益比 = 覆盖贡献 / 运行成本
metrics.method: cost-weighted (no runtime field) -> proxy = Shapley marginal coverage (682)
metrics.current_value: asan 19.53 > ubsan > tsan > cross-compile > compiler-warn > linker 0.71 > degenerate ~0
metrics.source: 682 Shapley / no cost field (future work per 685)

summary.key_honest_caveat: calibration requires 683 real target; efficiency cost-weighted requires runtime data (absent in matrix)
